info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Instrument Valuation Models API
info.description: The Financial Instrument Valuation Models API provides access to a comprehensive set of valuation models used in the banking sector for assessing the worth of various financial instruments. This API enables users to retrieve detailed information about different valuation methodologies and their applicable contexts. Typical consumers include financial analysts, risk managers, and developers integrating valuation data into financial applications. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their understanding of pricing models and improve decision-making processes surrounding financial instruments.

get.summary: Retrieve all financial instrument valuation models.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of financial instrument valuation models, which are essential for analyzing and valuing financial assets and securities. Use this resource to gain insights into the available models and their configurations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the financial instrument valuation models. It contains necessary parameters required for filtering and specifying the type of models to be returned.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested financial instrument valuation models.
